fields.contract_bytes:
schema_version: 1.0.0
contract_name: tia_fp_forward_entropy_stability_v1
contract_version: 1.0.0
description: >
  NEW forward experiment. Measures mean and std_dev of a seeded pseudo-random
  entropy sample corpus. Certificates ONLY if std_dev < gate_std_dev, with the
  full raw corpus persisted so the derived metric is recomputable. Establishes
  no claim about any historical T0 campaign.
provenance_policy:
  source_requires: commit_pinned
  contract_requires: hash_bound
  execution_requires: seed_pinned
  result_requires: payload_bytes_persisted
  raw_measurements_requires: corpus_persisted_as_json_array
  certificate_requires: validated_chain_to_raw_corpus
termination_contract:
  stop_if_any_edge_unverifiable: true
  never_declare_success_on: [matching_hashes, self_generated_metadata, execution_logs_exist, internal_assertions, regenerated_certificates]
parameters:
  sample_count: 1000
  gate_std_dev: 0.05
  aggregation: mean_stddev
  rounding: 6
audit_questions:
  what_was_run: "Entropy stability measurement over seeded sample corpus"
  against_what_source: "Tiannara-MindCache-Prosthetic commit-pinned in execution envelope"
  with_what_contract: "this contract (contract.bytes)"
  with_what_inputs: "seed, sample_count, raw corpus (persisted byte-for-byte)"
  using_what_environment: "otp/elixir/deps_lock_hash recorded in environment identity"
historical_boundary:
  t0_provenance: unresolved
  no_silent_upgrade_to_certified: true
